test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per census 2011, which of the following is the most spoken language of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Hindi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 43.63 percent of Indians speak Hindi as their mother tongue, as per the 2011 census.
 
• Bengali is second on the list with 8.03 percent speakers.
 
• Bengali is followed by Marathi at 3rd with 6.86 percent speakers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The 15th Indian census OR 7th after Independence was conducted in 2011.
 
• According to the 2011 census 
 
 
• ​Uttar Pradesh (Most populous state).
 
• Sikkim (Least populous state).
 
• Kerala (The most literate state in India-93.91%)
 
• Bihar ( Least literate state in India- 63.82%)
 
• Overall Literacy Rate of India (74.04%).
